# Security Policy

## Scope

This policy covers this static website and its GitHub Pages deployment: the pages, styles and scripts in this repository and the site published from it.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem. Report it privately by either:

- emailing **globalstackdigital@gmail.com**, or
- using GitHub private vulnerability reporting (the "Report a vulnerability" button on the Security tab of this repository).

Helpful details: a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, the potential impact, and a suggested fix if you have one.

## What to expect

We aim to acknowledge reports within 3 business days and to follow up as we investigate. These are goals, not guarantees.

## Out of scope

- Issues in third-party services or libraries (please report them to their maintainers)
- Theoretical issues without a way to reproduce them
